```{r}
data <- read.table(file = "TorusToyEg.txt", header = FALSE)
data <- as.matrix(data,ncol=6)
n = nrow(data)
plot3d(data[,4:6],col = rainbow(n))
plot3d(data[,1:3],col = rainbow(n))
dims = rep(2,2)
for(i in 1:nrow(data)){
  data[i,] <- normalize_poly(data[i,],dims)
}

angular = FALSE
landmark_size = .1
tol = 5e-3
landmark_tol = 5e-4
time <- Sys.time()
centroid_12 <-plot_MDS_py(x=data,dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol,gradient=TRUE)
print(Sys.time()-time)

```
```{r}
rgl.close()
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)
res <- invert_MDS(x = polyAnglesToSphere(data,dims), result = centroid_12, grid_size = 100, dims = dims, method = "RW")
rglwidget()
```

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Straight trends on (S^2)^2
set.seed(5)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = nspheres, sigma = 0.10)

scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
clusters = samp_3[,,1]
dims = rep(2,nspheres)
for (i in (2:nspheres)) {
  clusters <- cbind(clusters, samp_3[, , i])
}
dims = rep(2,nspheres)
angular = FALSE
landmark_size = .1
tol = 5e-3
landmark_tol = 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
centroid_12 <-plot_MDS_py(x=clusters,dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol,gradient= TRUE)
print(Sys.time()-time)

```

```{r}
close3d()
res <- invert_MDS(x = clusters, result = centroid_12, grid_size = 100, dims = dims, method = "both",angular=FALSE)
rglwidget()
```

```{r}
x <- clusters
mds <- centroid_12
init = "cmds"
angular = FALSE
dims = rep(2,nspheres)
col = NULL
method = "Main"
tol = 5e-3
landmark_tol = 5e-4
pc = 1
grid_size = 100
plot_pc = TRUE
gradient = TRUE
if(!angular){
    x <- polySphereToAngles(x,dims)
  }
  n <- nrow(x)
  d_sphere <- sum(dims)
  ind_dj <- comp_ind_dj(dims)
  comp_x <- mds$MDS_data
  rect_x <- polyAnglesToSphere(x,dims)
  
  # Evenly spaced points along first principal curve 
  sc <- march_PNS1_shapes(seq(0, mds$pns_info$radii[d_sphere] * 2 * pi, l = grid_size),
                          PNS = mds$pns_info
  )
  dist_initial <- dist_polysph_cross(sc, comp_x, ind_dj = comp_ind_dj(d_sphere), std = FALSE)
  
  range <- seq(1,n,floor(n/n))
  r_star <- mds$MDS_info$rstar
  poly_pc_initial <- weighted_polysphere(rows = nrow(sc), landmarks=rect_x[range,], dist_initial = dist_initial[,range], dims = dims )
  res <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(poly_pc_initial), ncol = sum(dims)+length(dims))
  
  for(i in 1:grid_size){
    resi <- optim(
      fn = poly_projection_stress,
      par = c(poly_pc_initial[i,]), r_star = r_star, yl = rect_x[range,], dims = dims,d_sphere = d_sphere, n = n, dist = dist_initial[i,range],
      method = "BFGS",
      control = list(reltol = tol)
    )
    res[i,] <- normalize_poly(resi$par,dims)
  }
  poly_pc_angle <- polySphereToAngles(res,dims)
  if(plot_pc){
    if(ncol(x) < 3){
      plot(rbind(x,poly_pc_angle),col=c(rainbow(n), rep("black", grid_size)),main = paste("First two Components"), axes = FALSE,
           xlab = "", ylab = "", pch = 19, xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
    } else{
      plot3d(rbind(x[,1:3],poly_pc_angle[,1:3]),col=c(rainbow(n), rep("black", grid_size)),
             xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", pch = 19)
    }
  }

```
